notifications.trigger: Sent (debounced 100ms) when the tool set changes; wired via setNotifyChange in src/server/index.ts.
notifications.note: Event-driven; not deterministically reproducible in a single capture run. Recorded here rather than faked. A conformance test (T-MCP-01) can trigger it by mutating memory between tools/list calls.

note: The server declares capabilities.tools.listChanged=true and capabilities.resources.listChanged=true, but only tools/list_changed is actually emitted in 0.21.0. resources/list_changed is declared but no resource handlers are registered in the captured build.
